basic_info.description: Beautiful traditional Edwardian building in Russian Hill with views of city and the Bay. Two 2 bedroom flats with a legal 1 bedroom garden unit. 2 flats offer quintessential San Francisco Marina style floor plan.  Top floor unit has newly finished hardwood floors. Both units have formal dining room and split bathroom. Legal 1 bedroom garden has access to backyard/patio. Large 2 car garage. Fantastic location close to landmarks in North Beach, Russian Hill, Nob Hill, Fishermans Wharf, Water front, public transportations to Union Sqaure, and just a few blocks from beach and Ghiradeli Sqaure and a lot more...
